# Test fixtures from alphaTab

Every file in this directory is copied **unmodified** from
`packages/alphatab/test-data/` in [CoderLine/alphaTab](https://github.com/CoderLine/alphaTab),
which is licensed under the **Mozilla Public License 2.0**. They are used here only as
parser test inputs. They are not StringSmith source and carry alphaTab's licence, not
this repository's.

| File | Origin path | Exercises |
|---|---|---|
| full-song.gp5 / .gpx / .gp | conversion/ | same 11-track song in GP5, GP6 and GP7 formats; linear tempo ramps bars 85-94 |
| accentuations.gp3 | guitarpro3/ | GP3 reader |
| bends.gp5 | guitarpro5/ | bend types and bend points |
| slides.gp5 | guitarpro5/ | shift / legato / out slides |
| harmonic-types.gp5 | guitarpro5/ | natural / artificial / pinch / tap / semi harmonics |
| effects.gp5, other-effects.gp5 | guitarpro5/ | vibrato, palm mute, let ring, staccato, tremolo, trill |
| chords.gp5 | guitarpro5/ | chord beats and chord diagrams |
| tuplets.gp5 | guitarpro5/ | non-binary durations |
| strokes.gp5 | guitarpro5/ | brush / pick stroke direction |
| repeat-close*.gp5 | audio/ | repeat signs, multi-repeats, alternate endings: the unrolling cases |
| grace-beats.gp, tied-bend-hammer.gp | audio/ | grace notes; tie + bend + hammer interactions |
| syncpoints-testfile.gp | audio/ | GP7 file carrying native sync points |
